Designed with a ribbed barbed profile, the plug grips tightly inside the hose, creating a reliable seal that prevents leaks and ensures water remains contained. Whether you are closing off unused outlets in irrigation systems, sealing pond hoses for maintenance, or temporarily stopping water pipes in DIY projects, this plug provides a cost-effective and efficient fix. Easy to install, simply push the barbed plug into the open end of the hose for a tight and watertight finish, with no need for tools. The durable ABS material resists corrosion, impact, and UV exposure, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use. Compact and lightweight, it helps keep hose systems tidy and controlled while reducing the risk of unwanted leaks or spills. A must-have for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this plug provides practical reliability for a variety of water flow management needs.

A must-have for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this plug provides practical reliability for a variety of water flow management needs.

product.name: 70mm - Black, Plastic Blanking End Cap Bung for Hose & Pipes
product.description: This Plastic Blanking Plug is a simple yet essential accessory for sealing off the end of hoses quickly and securely. Made from durable ABS plastic, it offers a tough, lightweight, and weather-resistant solution for stopping water flow in garden, pond, or general water pipe systems. Designed with a ribbed barbed profile, the plug grips tightly inside the hose, creating a reliable seal that prevents leaks and ensures water remains contained. Whether you are closing off unused outlets in irrigation systems, sealing pond hoses for maintenance, or temporarily stopping water pipes in DIY projects, this plug provides a cost-effective and efficient fix. Easy to install, simply push the barbed plug into the open end of the hose for a tight and watertight finish, with no need for tools. The durable ABS material resists corrosion, impact, and UV exposure, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use. Compact and lightweight, it helps keep hose systems tidy and controlled while reducing the risk of unwanted leaks or spills. A must-have for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this plug provides practical reliability for a variety of water flow management needs.

product.name: Pro-Spray Radiator Paint Anthracite Satin 400ml

product.name: Prime Radiator Paint Matt Black Spray 400ml
product.description:
Prime Home and Garden Radiator Paint is a fast and easy way to transform the look of radiators. Self-priming, this clever product works as a primer, undercoat & topcoat to provide a protective, durable finish.

Excellent adhesion and protection to most surfaces & resistance to cracking. Prime Radiator Paint can be applied directly to bare metal without the use of a primer.

High heat resistance of up to 100ºc Delivers a tough, heat resistant barrier to protect against everyday knocks, scuffs, and scratches, whilst also helping to prevent rust.

Prime Radiator Paint is available in two colours – White & Black in various finishes. 

Multi-Surface - Prime Radiator Paint can be used on a wide variety of indoor metal surfaces, including heating pipes and water tanks. Its excellent adhesion ensures durability and resistance to cracking, fading and peeling on each application. 

It provides a smooth, even finish, significantly enhancing the appearance of your heating elements.
